displayName: Block the Adobe Flash plug-in on specific sites (Obsolete)
description: This policy doesn't work because Flash is no longer supported by Microsoft Edge. Define a list of sites, based on URL patterns, that are blocked from running Adobe Flash. If you don't configure this policy, the global default value from the "DefaultPluginsSetting" policy (if set) or the user's personal configuration is used for all sites. For detailed information on valid url patterns, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2095322. However, starting in M85, patterns with '*' and '[*.]' wildcards in the host are no longer supported for this policy.
